captions.title: Marketers, then Buyers
captions.line: New means a marketer sent them in and nobody has called yet.

captions.title: Read what the marketer wrote
captions.line: Their own words, and the same list they read on their phone.

captions.title: Pick the move
captions.line: The commonest next step is already chosen, and the line under it says what it means.

captions.title: A reason and words, both required
captions.line: Pick why, then say what happened. The marketer reads both.

captions.title: It lands on their phone
captions.line: The move joins the history the moment you press it.

captions.title: Move it along again
captions.line: Called, then meeting booked. Every move needs its own reason.

captions.title: Nothing is overwritten
captions.line: Six months later it still says who did what, and why.

captions.title: She has left New
captions.line: Bought is the end of the line: it creates the deal and pays the marketer.
